prompt: Some people think it is no longer necessary for children to go to school because they can do all their learning online. Others believe learning in schools is essential. Discuss both views and give your opinion. Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
essay:
There is a debate over whether children must still go to school or whether studying online would be enough. While online learning brings multiple advantages, I believe that going to school is still necessary.

On the one hand, studying online is a beneficial development. This is because children can watch lectures and do their homework while staying at home. Therefore, parents and school buses are not needed to bring pupils to school and take them home again. As a result, traffic congestion will be reduced, especially in the morning. Moreover, buying books will not be necessary as everything can be done using only a laptop. From an environmental perspective, this can bring significant benefits to the environment, not to mention reducing the financial burden on parents who have to buy these books every year.

On the other hand, from my point of view, going to school and attending classes in person will remain essential. This is because children do not go to school only to study. Learning in schools can improve children's mental well-being and communication skills by allowing them to talk to their peers and make new friendships. In addition, school projects and activities play a significant role in helping children think outside the box and prepare them for their professional careers in the near future.

In conclusion, the concern about keeping children at home and letting them learn online is understandable. However, taking them to school can help them develop skills that are important for their future, in addition to their education.
